ten4ext.augment.power: Power ×%s (machines work faster, generators make more FE/t)
ten4ext.augment.stacking: One per augment slot · up to 4 per device, effects multiply
ten4ext.gui.solar_hint: Needs open sky above it during the day.
ten4ext.io.hint: Left-click: next · Right-click: previous · Middle-click: disable
ten4ext.jei.energy.hint_generator: Overclocking augments raise FE/t and burn the fuel faster.
ten4ext.jei.energy.hint_machine: Overclocking augments make it faster, not cheaper per operation.
ten4ext.jei.info.augments: Augments go into the Augments panel on the right of a device's GUI. Each of the 4 slots holds one augment, so a device can have at most 4; their effects multiply. Dismantling a device with sneak + wrench keeps its augments.
ten4ext.jei.info.biomass_generator: Burns plant matter for energy: logs, planks, saplings, leaves, flowers, crops, seeds, kelp, bamboo and more, including other mods' plants through their tags. Energy auto-eject is on when placed. See the Biomass Generating recipes for how much each fuel gives.
ten4ext.jei.info.farm_manager: Farms a 9x9 area around itself (from one block below to one above its own level). Mature crops are harvested and replanted with one of their own seeds; seeds in its left slots are planted on empty farmland. Works with any modded crop built on the vanilla crop block, plus nether wart. Uses 200 FE per harvest or planting; Overclocking augments make it sweep the field more often. Harvests are auto-ejected into adjacent inventories and ducts.
ten4ext.jei.info.solar_generator: Generates energy while it can see the sky during the day. Output follows the height of the sun and drops in rain and thunderstorms. Energy auto-eject is enabled when placed, so it powers adjacent ducts and devices right away. Overclocking Augments raise its output.
ten4ext.jei.info.wrench: Right-click a duct connection (the arm itself) to toggle it; click the bare core face on a side to reconnect. Duct-to-device connections cycle None → Normal → Push → Pull. Right-click a device to rotate it, sneak + right-click to dismantle it (it keeps its augments; Energy and Liquid Units also keep their contents).
